图片内文字：
- Status Update: New Indication(s) Evaluation for Verducatib Ongoing
- Request conditional approval for RoFD for TWO indications for asset maximization for verducatib.
- BUEC Decision in Mar 26.
- COPD:
  - Reactivation of the COPD program and RoFD were granted.
  - HAI starting from June, China CTA in Sep 2026.
- ANCA-AV:
  - RoFD not granted, but there are some follow ups to review and then BUEC will decide on the next steps.
- Next Steps for China team:
  - HAI in June, CTA in Sep 2026
  - Leading PI & Steering committee member proposal by Q2 2026

视觉关系：
- “BUEC Decision in Mar 26.”位于上方，作为对下方两条适应症（COPD、ANCA-AV）结论的共同决策节点/依据。
- COPD区块旁为绿色对勾标记，对应文本结论“Reactivation… and RoFD were granted”；并给出时间节点顺序：HAI（June）→ China CTA（Sep 2026）。
- ANCA-AV区块旁为红色禁止标记，对应文本结论“RoFD not granted”；并说明流程顺序：follow ups to review → BUEC will decide on the next steps。
- “Next Steps for China team”为后续行动列表，对应时间节点：HAI（June）与 CTA（Sep 2026），以及“Leading PI & Steering committee member proposal by Q2 2026”。
